primary_route: Optical/reporter deconvolution, target-product initial rates and substrate-by-compound kinetic matrix.

checks.reason: No pre-execution consultation of primary target/reporter assay Methods or validated protocols with a transfer check for the actual chemistry.
No compound/reagent identity, purity or authenticated stock-concentration check precedes the experiment; visual homogeneity alone does not establish integrity.

checks.quote: For all unreported parameters, establish them by calibration
checks.reason: Buffer, pH, temperature, cofactor conditions and exact preparation remain unknown without a concrete lookup or calibration-to-decision procedure. Stating calibrate every parameter is insufficient.
Calibration coverage and inversion are checked, but no predefined recovery/error/precision acceptance criterion establishes quantitative accuracy; monotonicity alone does not validate it.
Defines amount-versus-time conceptually but does not specify the reportable amount/concentration and time unit convention or a complete weak/missing quantitative endpoint rule.

Models and uncertainty are named, but the free-inhibitor versus total-inhibitor assumption/depletion check is absent. No branch handles tight binding before the standard competitive equation is interpreted.
Repair/redirection lacks a refreeze and fresh independent confirmation requirement after altered conditions.

Less calibrated product can also arise from substrate sequestration or product destruction during target incubation. Post-stop product spikes do not exclude those alternatives, so the target-directed decision is not identifying.

checks.quote: If a staged assay cannot be validated
checks.reason: Primary inference reuses the same reporter/fluorescence system with transfer curves. The alternative nonfluorescent measurement is unnamed and undeveloped; no operational independent chemistry measurement validates the corrected product estimate.
No specified raw-file/unit audit manifest or versioned executable analysis/settings retention allows another analyst to reconstruct the result.
Prospective vehicle, omission, reporter-only, fixed product/fluorophore and stopped-matrix controls have clear roles separating assay layers.

Prospective technical criteria and stops avoid outcome-selected removal and cover invalid quench, precipitation and noninvertible detector behavior; numeric pass details are a distinct P03 gap.
Explains target/reporter/detector separation and the need for compound-specific transfer functions and invertibility; kinetic patterns are not structural proof.
Sets ranges from vehicle kinetic transition and soluble/valid reporter range and freezes series, timing and exclusions before confirmation; the missing buffer-setting procedure is separately P02.
